This video is about a book, How Music Works by David Byrne, the singer from Talking Heads. It's big idea is that music is shaped by the room it's played in. I wanted to know how that shaping actually happens, so I went looking for people who measured it. Here's what I found. The room doesn't write the music, it asks a question. A player hears it and answers. And different players answer the same room in different ways.
